metadata.description: The Make PPTX skills: your notes turned into a finished PowerPoint deck. One entry per available skill.

plugins.name: make-clean-pptx
plugins.description: Turns your notes into PowerPoint decks from tested slide layouts and editable charts, checked before delivery.

plugins.name: make-style-pptx
plugins.description: Gives a clean deck another look: new card shapes, staggered or arced layouts and quiet backgrounds, with the same content. Preview.

plugins.name: make-colors-pptx
plugins.description: Turns your brand guidelines, website, example files or logo into a readable PowerPoint theme and applies it to a deck. Preview.
